messages: Ivy: heads-up - on the perf dashboard the legend is overflowing into the tooltip area when panels are narrow. repro: open /dash/perf with >10 series. screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/legend-overflow-02.png Marco: yep saw that. root cause looks like long unit suffixes in names (eg "p95 latency (client ms)") + wrapping legend. Sophie: quick win: truncate series names in legend to 28 chars and show full name in tooltip. also add small unit chips to the right of each name (ms, req/s, %). Julian: unit chips sound good. keep them semantic: ms. make chip aria-hidden=false and include aria-label with full text ("milliseconds"). a11y: please ensure chips meet 4.5:1 contrast and are in the SR reading order after the series name. Ivy: another problem: smoothing toggle changes which series are "Top N" for collapsed legend. Users get confused when order jumps after switching smoothing. Marco: proposal: legend ranking should be tied to the current render mode (raw vs smoothed). add indicator next to legend header: "Ranking: smoothed" or "Ranking: raw" with a tooltip explaining why. Sophie: alternative: keep ranking stable by default (use raw values for ranking) and add an option "rank by smoothed" in the legend menu. lowers surprise. Julian: implementation note: API can return both rawValue and smoothedValue in the timeseries result; client picks ranking strategy. payload example: {"rawValue":"120","smoothedValue":"98"} (we'll send as strings). a11y: SR pattern: legend header should have aria-live region that announces ranking changes like "Legend: showing top 5 of 12 series; ranking by smoothed value". Ivy: outlier markers are very high-contrast red and draw attention away from baseline lines. suggestion: add attenuation mode in legend (global toggle + per-series override) that fades markers to 60% opacity and reduces radius. show a small badge in the legend when attenuation is active. Marco: backend can compute a spikeFlag boolean per series to indicate recent outliers, cheap to add. client maps spikeFlag + attenuation -> final marker style. default: attenuation off. Sophie: microcopy: toggle label "Attenuate transient spikes" tooltip: "Reduce marker emphasis for short-lived spikes to focus on trend." keep under 100 chars. Julian: CSS snippet for attenuated marker: .code: .marker-attenuated { opacity: 0.6; r: 3px; transition: r 120ms, opacity 120ms; } Ivy: accessibility nit: collapsed legend should announce how many items are hidden and provide a keyboard-focusable "expand" control. SR text example: "Expand legend, 7 series hidden". Use aria-controls to point to the expanded list. a11y: also recommend keyboard shortcuts: press L to focus legend, Enter to toggle expand, Arrow keys to move through items, D to toggle denoise/attenuation when focused. document these in the panel help. Sophie: small UX: show a faint badge in the legend title when smoothing changes the ranking: "Ranking uses current smoothing" (info icon). clicking opens ephemeral tooltip explaining exact algorithm. Marco: action items: Julian -> add spikeFlag + raw/smoothed values to API draft; Sophie -> mock collapsed legend + unit chips and microcopy; Ivy -> create a11y acceptance criteria and keyboard mapping; I'll schedule a 30m design-review Weds. ops-bot: Upload complete: https://redwood.example/design/legend-chip-proto.png
